pattern_name: Claim class is broader than the evidence class
claim_type: A manuscript advances a general chemistry claim from a narrow reaction, material, molecular system, or assay.
evidence_risk: The demonstrated evidence may support a local finding but not the full mechanistic, synthetic, or generality claim.
reviewer_concern: The demonstrated evidence may support a local finding but not the full mechanistic, synthetic, or generality claim.
revision_direction: Ask authors to recalibrate language, separate demonstrated scope from hypotheses, and state the exact evidence domain.

pattern_name: Demonstration is not equivalent to explanation
claim_type: A successful reaction, catalyst, sensor, or molecular tool is presented as mechanistically explained.
evidence_risk: Performance alone does not establish the chemical origin of the effect.
reviewer_concern: Performance alone does not establish the chemical origin of the effect.
revision_direction: Require explicit mechanistic alternatives, discriminating experiments, and limits on causal wording.

pattern_name: Best-case examples anchor the central message
claim_type: A conclusion relies on unusually successful substrates, catalysts, cells, or operating windows.
evidence_risk: The claim may be driven by cherry-picked conditions rather than representative behaviour.
reviewer_concern: The claim may be driven by cherry-picked conditions rather than representative behaviour.
revision_direction: Request full distributions, failed cases, boundary cases, and transparent selection criteria.

pattern_name: Incremental chemistry is framed as conceptual novelty
claim_type: A manuscript introduces a term or framing for chemistry already present in adjacent literature.
evidence_risk: Originality may be overstated if prior conceptual precedents are not acknowledged.
reviewer_concern: Originality may be overstated if prior conceptual precedents are not acknowledged.
revision_direction: Require a precise novelty statement against the closest reaction class, catalyst family, molecular design, or analytical approach.

claim_type: A study positions itself within one chemical literature while overlooking catalysis, materials, chemical biology, or physical chemistry precedents.
evidence_risk: The manuscript may appear more novel than it is because the comparator set is incomplete.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may appear more novel than it is because the comparator set is incomplete.
revision_direction: Ask for broader, cross-subfield literature positioning and explicit differences from the closest analogues.

claim_type: New labels are used for effects that may arise from known chemical principles.
evidence_risk: A term can obscure whether the contribution is a new mechanism, new system, or new application.
reviewer_concern: A term can obscure whether the contribution is a new mechanism, new system, or new application.
revision_direction: Require authors to define terms operationally and distinguish naming from evidence of a new principle.

claim_type: A reaction, catalytic activity, imaging signal, binding event, or chemical-biology response is attributed to the designed component.
evidence_risk: Without negative controls, background chemistry or assay artefacts can explain the result.
reviewer_concern: Without negative controls, background chemistry or assay artefacts can explain the result.
revision_direction: Require blank, inactive analogue, no-light/no-current/no-enzyme/no-metal, or scrambled-control tests as appropriate.

claim_type: The comparator differs in loading, surface area, concentration, solvent, illumination, potential, assay window, or normalization.
evidence_risk: The comparison may conflate intrinsic chemistry with experimental setup.
reviewer_concern: The comparison may conflate intrinsic chemistry with experimental setup.
revision_direction: Ask for matched controls and normalization to chemically meaningful denominators.

claim_type: Performance is supported by the same platform, dataset, instrument, or condition used for discovery.
evidence_risk: Internal validation can overstate robustness.
reviewer_concern: Internal validation can overstate robustness.
revision_direction: Request independent validation, orthogonal analytical methods, external datasets, or held-out substrate classes.

claim_type: A synthesis or catalytic method is claimed as general from a narrow or biased substrate set.
evidence_risk: Substrate scope may not test steric, electronic, functional-group, heteroatom, stereochemical, or scale boundaries.
reviewer_concern: Substrate scope may not test steric, electronic, functional-group, heteroatom, stereochemical, or scale boundaries.
revision_direction: Require a scope table designed around chemical diversity, limitations, and failed substrates.

pattern_name: Selectivity origin is asserted rather than tested
claim_type: Regio-, chemo-, stereo-, or enantioselectivity is explained by a proposed structural or mechanistic feature.
evidence_risk: The proposed origin can be plausible but unproven.
reviewer_concern: The proposed origin can be plausible but unproven.
revision_direction: Ask for competition experiments, matched substrate pairs, kinetic probes, isotopic tests, or computational selectivity models.

pattern_name: Yields are reported without comparability context
claim_type: Reaction performance is discussed without consistent conversion, isolated yield, selectivity, mass balance, or scale information.
evidence_risk: Readers cannot assess practical utility or compare with existing methods.
reviewer_concern: Readers cannot assess practical utility or compare with existing methods.
revision_direction: Require harmonized reporting of conversion, isolated yield, selectivity, side products, scale, and purification losses.

pattern_name: Identity evidence is insufficient for a key compound
claim_type: A central molecule, intermediate, catalyst, polymer, framework, or labelled product lacks orthogonal characterization.
evidence_risk: Misassignment or impurity can compromise the core conclusion.
reviewer_concern: Misassignment or impurity can compromise the core conclusion.
revision_direction: Request appropriate NMR, HRMS, elemental analysis, crystallography, chromatography, spectroscopy, or purity evidence.

pattern_name: Purity and batch variability are not controlled
claim_type: Chemical performance depends on synthesized materials or molecular samples with limited batch documentation.
evidence_risk: Impurities, morphology, counterions, residual metal, or solvent can drive apparent effects.
reviewer_concern: Impurities, morphology, counterions, residual metal, or solvent can drive apparent effects.
revision_direction: Require batch-to-batch data, purity metrics, impurity screens, and synthetic reproducibility evidence.

claim_type: Spectroscopic or diffraction data are used to assign local structure, oxidation state, binding mode, or packing.
evidence_risk: The data may be consistent with several chemical structures or environments.
reviewer_concern: The data may be consistent with several chemical structures or environments.
revision_direction: Require orthogonal methods, uncertainty in fitting, standards, controls, and alternative structural models.

claim_type: Activity, selectivity, or molecular response is correlated with a structural descriptor, spectroscopic feature, or computed parameter.
evidence_risk: Correlation does not identify the operative mechanism.
reviewer_concern: Correlation does not identify the operative mechanism.
revision_direction: Request perturbation experiments, kinetic discrimination, isotope effects, intermediate trapping, or direct observation where feasible.

claim_type: A single pathway is presented for a reaction, catalytic cycle, photochemical process, or biological response.
evidence_risk: Competing radical, ionic, surface, solvent, transport, or degradation pathways may explain the observations.
reviewer_concern: Competing radical, ionic, surface, solvent, transport, or degradation pathways may explain the observations.
revision_direction: Require a mechanism section that tests and narrows plausible alternatives.

claim_type: A catalyst or material is assigned a specific active site or coordination environment.
evidence_risk: Spectroscopic and performance evidence may not separate spectator sites from active sites.
reviewer_concern: Spectroscopic and performance evidence may not separate spectator sites from active sites.
revision_direction: Request operando/in situ evidence, poisoning or site-blocking tests, isotope/kinetic probes, and reconstruction analysis.

pattern_name: Activity metrics are not intrinsically normalized
claim_type: Catalytic performance is reported by mass, geometric area, mole of material, optical density, or total product.
evidence_risk: Observed performance may reflect surface area, loading, morphology, mass transport, or light absorption rather than intrinsic activity.
reviewer_concern: Observed performance may reflect surface area, loading, morphology, mass transport, or light absorption rather than intrinsic activity.
revision_direction: Ask for normalization by active site, electrochemically active surface area, absorbed photons, turnover metrics, or matched loading.

pattern_name: Stability evidence is too short or too idealized
claim_type: A catalyst is claimed stable under limited time, cycling, current, illumination, solvent, or substrate stress.
evidence_risk: Short tests cannot exclude deactivation, reconstruction, leaching, fouling, or product inhibition.
reviewer_concern: Short tests cannot exclude deactivation, reconstruction, leaching, fouling, or product inhibition.
revision_direction: Require longer-term operation, post-catalysis characterization, leaching analysis, and activity recovery tests.

claim_type: Catalytic selectivity or efficiency is reported without complete product accounting.
evidence_risk: Faradaic, photon, atom, carbon, nitrogen, or mass balances may be incomplete.
reviewer_concern: Faradaic, photon, atom, carbon, nitrogen, or mass balances may be incomplete.
revision_direction: Require calibration curves, detection limits, isotopic controls, product balance, and uncertainty propagation.

pattern_name: Computation is used as confirmation rather than a falsifiable test
claim_type: DFT, quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, or ML models are aligned with the preferred mechanism.
evidence_risk: Calculations can rationalize observations without discriminating alternatives.
reviewer_concern: Calculations can rationalize observations without discriminating alternatives.
revision_direction: Require model assumptions, sensitivity to functional/model/solvent/surface, competing pathways, and clear limits.

pattern_name: Model chemistry is mismatched to experiment
claim_type: A simplified molecule, cluster, slab, solvation environment, protein model, or reaction coordinate represents a complex experiment.
evidence_risk: The model may omit counterions, solvent, morphology, dynamics, concentration, defects, or interface structure.
reviewer_concern: The model may omit counterions, solvent, morphology, dynamics, concentration, defects, or interface structure.
revision_direction: Ask authors to justify the model and test whether conclusions are robust to chemically plausible alternatives.

claim_type: A computational or AI chemistry workflow is presented as predictive from retrospective benchmarks.
evidence_risk: Performance may not transfer to new chemotypes, substrates, catalysts, or experimental conditions.
reviewer_concern: Performance may not transfer to new chemotypes, substrates, catalysts, or experimental conditions.
revision_direction: Require prospective tests, scaffold splits, out-of-domain examples, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis.

claim_type: Chemical measurements are summarized without clear biological, synthetic, instrumental, or technical replicate definitions.
evidence_risk: Uncertainty may be underestimated or not independent.
reviewer_concern: Uncertainty may be underestimated or not independent.
revision_direction: Require replicate definitions, sample sizes, error propagation, statistical tests, and raw/processed data availability.

pattern_name: Small differences are interpreted as chemical effects
claim_type: Claims depend on modest changes in yield, selectivity, rate, binding, or spectroscopic parameters.
evidence_risk: The difference may fall within experimental or fitting uncertainty.
reviewer_concern: The difference may fall within experimental or fitting uncertainty.
revision_direction: Ask for confidence intervals, significance analysis where appropriate, and practical-effect thresholds.

claim_type: Kinetic, spectroscopic, binding, or computational fits are used to infer parameters.
evidence_risk: Parameter identifiability and covariance can affect the interpretation.
reviewer_concern: Parameter identifiability and covariance can affect the interpretation.
revision_direction: Request residuals, confidence intervals, fitting models, parameter sensitivity, and raw data.

pattern_name: Chemical specificity in biological systems is insufficient
claim_type: A probe, inhibitor, binder, labelling reagent, or molecular perturbation is used to infer biological function.
evidence_risk: Off-target chemistry, permeability, metabolism, toxicity, or nonspecific binding can drive effects.
reviewer_concern: Off-target chemistry, permeability, metabolism, toxicity, or nonspecific binding can drive effects.
revision_direction: Require orthogonal probes, inactive analogues, rescue experiments, dose response, and target engagement evidence.

pattern_name: Biological assay readout is treated as direct chemistry
claim_type: Cellular or biomolecular activity is attributed to a designed chemical interaction.
evidence_risk: Assay response integrates uptake, stability, localization, downstream signalling, and toxicity.
reviewer_concern: Assay response integrates uptake, stability, localization, downstream signalling, and toxicity.
revision_direction: Ask for mechanistic separation of chemical binding/reactivity from biological response.

pattern_name: Protein or biomolecular dynamics interpretation is overextended
claim_type: Spectroscopic or structural data are used to infer functional dynamics.
evidence_risk: The method may report a specific timescale, state, or construct rather than the general biological mechanism.
reviewer_concern: The method may report a specific timescale, state, or construct rather than the general biological mechanism.
revision_direction: Require construct controls, timescale limits, orthogonal measurements, and cautious wording.

pattern_name: Materials performance is interpreted without chemical boundary control
claim_type: A material, electrode, polymer, framework, nanostructure, or interface exhibits desirable performance.
evidence_risk: Performance may reflect morphology, transport, defects, additives, electrolyte, or device architecture rather than chemical design alone.
reviewer_concern: Performance may reflect morphology, transport, defects, additives, electrolyte, or device architecture rather than chemical design alone.
revision_direction: Require matched morphology/device controls and chemical-interface characterization.

pattern_name: Interface chemistry is inferred from ex situ evidence
claim_type: Interfacial composition or active phase is assigned after operation.
evidence_risk: Ex situ data may miss transient states or air-sensitive reconstruction.
reviewer_concern: Ex situ data may miss transient states or air-sensitive reconstruction.
revision_direction: Require operando/in situ evidence where feasible and explicit limits on ex situ interpretation.

pattern_name: Scale-up or practical relevance is overstated
claim_type: A chemistry is linked to sustainability, recycling, energy, or industrial relevance from laboratory-scale evidence.
evidence_risk: Laboratory success may not address feedstock variability, cost, durability, safety, or process integration.
reviewer_concern: Laboratory success may not address feedstock variability, cost, durability, safety, or process integration.
revision_direction: Ask for scope of practical claims, process metrics, and realistic comparison to incumbent chemistry.

pattern_name: Synthetic procedure is not reproducible enough
claim_type: A key result depends on a procedure with missing concentrations, atmosphere, light intensity, electrode geometry, purification, timing, or material history.
evidence_risk: Small procedural changes can alter chemistry.
reviewer_concern: Small procedural changes can alter chemistry.
revision_direction: Require complete experimental details, instrument settings, calibration, and batch history.

claim_type: Claims depend on spectra, chromatograms, images, simulations, or code that are only summarized.
evidence_risk: Readers cannot audit assignments, quantification, or model outputs.
reviewer_concern: Readers cannot audit assignments, quantification, or model outputs.
revision_direction: Require raw spectra/chromatograms, processing scripts, coordinate files, computational inputs, and accession links.

claim_type: Different figures or experiments report different denominators, conditions, units, or normalization.
evidence_risk: Inconsistent reporting weakens comparability.
reviewer_concern: Inconsistent reporting weakens comparability.
revision_direction: Request harmonized units, tables of conditions, and source-data alignment.

pattern_name: Definitions are rhetorically strong but operationally vague
claim_type: Terms such as hierarchical, robust, efficient, stable, green, universal, or programmable are used without thresholds.
evidence_risk: Ambiguous terms make claims difficult to evaluate.
reviewer_concern: Ambiguous terms make claims difficult to evaluate.
revision_direction: Ask for operational definitions, quantitative thresholds, and evidence for each descriptor.

claim_type: A figure, table, or supplementary result is cited as supporting a specific claim.
evidence_risk: The plotted evidence may not show the claimed comparison or the conditions may be unclear.
reviewer_concern: The plotted evidence may not show the claimed comparison or the conditions may be unclear.
revision_direction: Require clearer labels, controls, sample sizes, uncertainty, and direct statement of what the figure establishes.

pattern_name: Nomenclature and chemical notation reduce auditability
claim_type: Compound names, catalyst labels, structures, charge states, stereochemistry, or abbreviations are inconsistent.
evidence_risk: Auditability and reproducibility suffer.
reviewer_concern: Auditability and reproducibility suffer.
revision_direction: Ask for consistent nomenclature, structure files, labels, and abbreviation definitions.

claim_type: late-stage or method-development claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits substrate diversity, functional-group tolerance, selectivity, and preparative utility.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong late-stage or method-development claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit substrate diversity, functional-group tolerance, selectivity, and preparative utility.

claim_type: catalytic performance claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits normalization, active-site identity, product closure, and stability.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong catalytic performance claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit normalization, active-site identity, product closure, and stability.

claim_type: light-driven chemistry claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits photon flux, absorption, quenching, ROS/product quantification, and dark controls.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong light-driven chemistry claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit photon flux, absorption, quenching, ROS/product quantification, and dark controls.

claim_type: electrochemical activity claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits reference electrode calibration, iR correction, mass transport, Faradaic efficiency, and post-test phase.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong electrochemical activity claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit reference electrode calibration, iR correction, mass transport, Faradaic efficiency, and post-test phase.

claim_type: chemical-biology mechanism claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits target engagement, off-target chemistry, orthogonal probes, and biological assay specificity.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong chemical-biology mechanism claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit target engagement, off-target chemistry, orthogonal probes, and biological assay specificity.

claim_type: polymer or macromolecular claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits molecular-weight distribution, dispersity, composition, degradation, and batch reproducibility.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong polymer or macromolecular claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit molecular-weight distribution, dispersity, composition, degradation, and batch reproducibility.

claim_type: assembly or host–guest claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits stoichiometry, binding model, concentration dependence, morphology, and alternative assemblies.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong assembly or host–guest claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit stoichiometry, binding model, concentration dependence, morphology, and alternative assemblies.

claim_type: structure–property claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits phase purity, morphology, defect chemistry, interface state, and matched materials controls.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong structure–property claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit phase purity, morphology, defect chemistry, interface state, and matched materials controls.

claim_type: computed chemistry claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits model system, sensitivity, competing pathways, uncertainty, and experimental validation.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong computed chemistry claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit model system, sensitivity, competing pathways, uncertainty, and experimental validation.

claim_type: measurement or mapping claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits calibration, limits of detection, matrix effects, standards, and uncertainty.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong measurement or mapping claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit calibration, limits of detection, matrix effects, standards, and uncertainty.

claim_type: sustainability claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits mass balance, solvent/reagent burden, energy input, feedstock variability, and practical comparator.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong sustainability claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit mass balance, solvent/reagent burden, energy input, feedstock variability, and practical comparator.

claim_type: energy-conversion or storage chemistry claim
evidence_risk: The claim can be accepted only if the evidence chain audits device-normalized versus chemistry-normalized performance, degradation, and interface evolution.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may make a strong energy-conversion or storage chemistry claim while leaving one or more critical audit layers under-specified.
revision_direction: Require authors to explicitly test, quantify, or delimit device-normalized versus chemistry-normalized performance, degradation, and interface evolution.
